klaim.bukti: The present review scrutinizes the following non-destructive ripeness classification methods: spectroscopy, inductive sensing, thermal imaging, light detection and ranging, laser-light backscattering imaging, and computer vision.
klaim.catatan: Tinjauan sawit yang disusun per metode pengindraan kematangan; sesuai.

klaim.bukti: A compelling solution emerges in the fusion of light detection and ranging and computer vision techniques. [...] Furthermore, this fusion yields added value in terms of localization and mapping
klaim.catatan: Fusi LiDAR dengan visi komputer dan nilai tambah lokalisasi dinyatakan di abstrak dan seksi Challenges and Future Prospects.

klaim.bukti: Unlike previous review articles, the present rigorous systematic review ensures a methodical meta-analysis [...] A structured approach was used to select relevant sources for a comprehensive and informative review.
klaim.perbaikan: Replace "Not stated" with "Self-described systematic; no databases, search strings, or study counts reported".
klaim.catatan: Cakupan (klasifikasi kematangan TBS) dan sumbu (teknik pengindraan) benar. Sel 'Not stated' kurang tepat: artikel menyebut dirinya 'rigorous systematic review' dengan 'structured approach', tetapi tidak melaporkan basis data, string kueri, PRISMA, maupun jumlah kajian. Tidak ada bahasan identitas lintas pandang atau pencacahan tandan; 'No' sesuai.

klaim.bukti: A systematic review was structured to answer seven predefined research questions by analysing 61 papers after applying exclusion criteria. The works analysed were categorized into two main groups: (1) regression analysis [...] and (2) classification techniques
klaim.catatan: Rentang 2011-2020, 61 makalah, protokol PRISMA, dan pengelompokan regresi/klasifikasi cocok. Analisis TBS terbatas pada kematangan; tidak ada bahasan identitas lintas pandang.

klaim.bukti: this paper main contribution is to provide an understanding of the utilisation of deep learning and its application in oil palm tree counting.
klaim.catatan: Abstrak menegaskan objeknya pencacahan pohon sawit (bukan tandan) dengan deep learning, tetapi tidak menyebut UAV maupun galat pencacahan ulang. Bagian 're-counting errors' dan 'UAV images' perlu dicek pada teks lengkap, yang tidak terjangkau.

klaim.bukti: a hyperspectral-based system was introduced to detect the ripeness of oil palm fresh fruit bunches (FFB). The FFBs were scanned using a hyperspectral device, and reflectance was recorded at different wavelengths.
klaim.catatan: Pencitraan hiperspektral 400-1000 nm pada tandan yang sudah dipanen (di atas konveyor/x-stage, dalam ruang); sesuai, termasuk keterangan 'on harvested bunches'.

klaim.bukti: With the exception of FPN-linear, which performed similarly across all sequence sizes, count estimates from multiple frames were significantly more accurate than those based on a single frame (considering a significance level α = 0.05).
klaim.catatan: Jeruk, regresi cacah buah tampak dari 1 bingkai vs segmen 3/7/11 bingkai, uji Wilcoxon signed-rank; sesuai. Kualifikasi: signifikan pada 2 dari 3 model (EfficientNetB0 dan FPN-map), tidak pada FPN-linear; penurunan MedAE 22-25% pada 11 bingkai.
